reviewItem.question: For "spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook: Use `0.16.1` as opposed to `0.16.0` on your installation…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

of.needed: which installation paths or existing CRD conversion settings trigger the Forbidden spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig error when applying 0.16.0

proposed.statement: Installing or upgrading to 0.16.0 can fail with "spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook"; upstream says to use 0.16.1 instead, where this is fixed.
